item.title: Great at gaming? US air traffic control wants you to apply
item.description:
📝 The FAA said last year that it would be considered fully staffed with 14,663 active controllers. Nick Daniels, president of the National Air Traffic Controllers Association, a labour union that represents controllers, said unions supported the strategy of recruiting gamers to tackle the shortage. The recruitment drive comes after several high-profile incidents involving aircraft and air traffic control.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ce84rvx0e6do
